summary: Sultan Kudarat 1st District representative with 24 principal-authored bills. Authored an electricity lifeline rate for minimum wage earners, the Kalinga program as a national emergency response framework, travel-tax abolition, a constitutional right to access information and a prohibition on deliberate false information posing harm. Co-authored a national nutrition program, fuel-tax suspension, a cybersecurity agency and a bill fixing barangay terms.
caveat: FOI and disinformation are each a single issue in their dimensions and left unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored an electricity lifeline rate for minimum wage earners and the Kalinga emergency response program (-2, social provision), against travel tax abolition (+1). Two issues.
